evals.name: meeting-moved-office
evals.prompt: post in the team group: sprint demo moved from wed 11 nov 3pm to thu 12 nov 11am because the client asked. same meet link https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij. please update your demo slides in the shared deck https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZ by wed 6pm. from Kunal (Eng Manager)
evals.expected_output: A group announcement with a headline saying the demo moved to Thu 12 Nov 11 am, the old time struck through or clearly shown as old, both links exactly, the slide deadline, and Kunal's sign-off.
assertions: Headline says the demo moved and gives the new date/time
Both links appear exactly and unformatted
The Wed 6 pm slide deadline is stated

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally
